title: Solo Leveling in Three Clues: Works, Seasons, Songs and Places
description: Ten rounds of three growing clues each, to name a Solo Leveling novel, comic, season, song, film, dungeon, guild or army. Light spoilers up to Season 2.
notes: Clues format: three progressive clues per question lead to a work, season, song, film, place, guild or force; no character is named as the answer.

questions.question: Which version of Solo Leveling do these clues describe?
clues: It is the oldest form of the story.
Chugong wrote it, and KakaoPage first carried it in July 2016.
A printed edition came out that November from the Papyrus label of D&C Media.

questions.question: Which version of Solo Leveling do these clues describe?
clues: It is a comic that adapts the original text.
It was released in two seasons, the first of which ended in March 2020.
KakaoPage began serializing it in March 2018, and it finished in December 2021.

questions.question: Which part of the anime do these clues describe?
clues: A-1 Pictures animated it.
A compilation film retelling it reached Japanese cinemas in late 2024.
A recap special that aired on 25 February 2024 covered its first seven episodes.
options: The sequel film Beyond the System

questions.question: Which part of the anime do these clues describe?
clues: It was made by the same studio as the first season.
It starts directly where the first season left off.
Its first two episodes were shown in Japanese cinemas together with a compilation film of the first season.

questions.question: Which theme song do these clues describe?
clues: It is a theme tune of the first season of the anime.
It plays at the start of the episodes, not at the end.
A K-pop group, Tomorrow X Together, joins the SawanoHiroyuki[nZk] project on it.

questions.question: Which title do these clues describe?
clues: It is a feature-length production, not a TV series.
It was announced as a sequel to the anime.
The anime's official site shows it as being in production.

questions.question: Which adaptation do these clues describe?
clues: Its characters are played by real actors rather than drawn.
Netflix is behind it.
Byeon Woo-seok is cast as Sung Jin-woo.

questions.question: Which place in the story do these clues describe?
clues: A hunter party goes in and almost nobody comes back.
It is a rare dungeon of overwhelming strength, and it changes Jin-woo's life.
Lee Joo-hee and Song Chi-yul both made it out alive.

questions.question: Which guild do these clues describe?
clues: It is a hunter guild led by an S-Rank Hunter.
Its master specialises in transformation magic.
That master was the first S-Rank to spot that Jin-woo can grow.

questions.question: Which force do these clues describe?
clues: Its members are not living humans.
Unlike the summons of other Hunters, they can grow and even talk.
They were raised from death by the power of a monarch.
